description: List the schemas and tables available in NOIRLab Astro Data Lab, with each table's description and row count — or the columns of one named table. CALL THIS BEFORE WRITING A QUERY: Data Lab holds ~130 schemas and the table names are survey-specific ("ls_dr10.tractor", "gaia_dr3.gaia_source", "des_dr2.main"), so a guessed name is a query error rather than an empty result. AUTHORITATIVE for which survey data releases NOIRLab actually serves and how big each one is.

schema.description: Schema to list tables for, e.g. "gaia_dr3", "ls_dr10", "des_dr2". Omit to list every schema (survey data release) instead.

table.description: Fully-qualified table name, e.g. "gaia_dr3.gaia_source", to list its columns, units and descriptions instead of listing tables.

name: datalab_tables
title: Datalab Tables
